definition: a solid piece of something with flat sides
description: A close shot of an unfinished wall built from large pale building blocks with thin mortar joints between them, under a window that looks out over a foggy green field. A hand in a grey work glove holds a cut-off clear plastic bottle flat against the blocks, directly under the tip of a drill. The drill bores into the block and the grey dust falls straight down into the bottle instead of onto the floor. When the drilling stops, the hand lifts the bottle away to show a neat round hole in the block and a heap of grey dust collected inside the bottle.
